notes.title: Demo Version 2 Is Out Now!
notes.content:
What's New in Demo V2


 Spaceships can now be spotted flying around just outside the windows. There also seems to be a new planet out there too. I wonder if that has any importance?
 Five more corridor variants for you to try and spot.
 Save data and settings are now included. Unlocking the speedrun mode will now be permanent along with any changes to volume or quality in the settings page.
 Bug fixes including a major issue causing game crashes.


Why This Matters

This update gives you a better look at what the full game will be like and helps me to gather more feedback. If you played the first demo, I would love to hear how this one compares.

How to Play

Just go to the store page, hit Download Demo, and you'll get the latest version.

Thanks for Playing

I truly appreciate all of your support. Drop your thoughts in the Discord, it really helps.
- Blott Jeb
